measurement_classification.eligible_label_type_in_principle: Calibrated medium concentration changes and properly derived net exchange measurements
measurement_classification.verified_lineage: mediaSummary contains aggregated concentration changes and uncertainties; source code multiplies these by actual dilution rate before optimization. Exact molecular scale and biomass/cell-volume conversion still need source binding.
measurement_classification.restrictions: Not an individual intracellular enzyme rate. The model-ready input additionally removes measured phosphate information and constructs an approximated oxygen constraint; those transformations must not be mislabeled raw measurements.

measurement_classification.classification: Experimental LC-MS/MS, with source normalization and censoring; calibrated concentration only where a complete standards/reference lineage exists
measurement_classification.restrictions: Whole-cell, prior-culture measurements; relative ion counts are not cytosolic mM. Shared references and published global transformations cannot be ignored. Do not split aggregate analyte names into unmeasured molecular species.

measurement_classification.classification: Processed relative protein abundance, with reported KNN imputation
measurement_classification.restrictions: No absolute active enzyme amount; no imputation flag in verified TSV; exact file transform unresolved. Protein gene IDs or detection do not establish kinetic capacity.

measurement_classification.classification: An independently acquired assay can validate a scoped activity response only with source-bound raw observations, preparation/group IDs, matching conditions and a frozen observation adapter
measurement_classification.restrictions: Methods citations and plotted fitted curves are not raw label receipts. Crude-extract activity is not kcat; purified total protein without active fraction does not establish intrinsic turnover. Paper-selected assay hypotheses entail replication.

confirmed.fact: Internal reaction labels depend on modified YEASTNET 7, boundary constraint fitting and FVA. Avoiding local GEM files alone would not remove this inherited model prior.
Boer metabolomics is an ancestor reused by Hackett. It is not independent holdout data merely because supplied under another filename.
The existing build uses DLKcat prediction, fuzzy kcat matching, isozyme/standard-value selection and growth-directed sensitivity tuning. Those are not independent experimental measurements.
Existing artifact source versions include yeast-GEM 9.0.2, ecYeastGEM based on yeast-GEM 8.3.4, and a GECKO 3.2.5 build on yeast-GEM 9.0.2. No frozen model was edited or used for fitting.
